mentions.title: No more King XP bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer of the King XP series received an unopened package with mismatched shells (8 upper .011, 7 lower .011, 1 lower .030) and ended the thread recommending others not buy King bearings, criticising the company's standard operating procedure. Explicit buyer-warning tone on King's flagship performance line.
mentions.replyNote: A new member account identifying as King Bearings posted an official response on 2026-08-04 addressing the precision concerns; thread remains open.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: King STDX thrust bearings for BMW S85 and S65 engines reported as over 1mm too narrow to fit multiple blocks that measured consistently, pointing at a dimensional defect rather than an install error. Warranty implication on a specific part number.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread on a diesel truck forum about King main thrust bearings. Framed as a caution to other builders rather than a support question.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Customer received a wrong-clearance bearing shipment and complains primarily about King's handling of the warranty claim rather than the part itself; later posts attribute the mis-ship to the distributor. Service-experience complaint.

mentions.title: King Bearing Failures?
mentions.snippet: King main and rod bearings reported damaged during initial startup and break-in on a high-compression 408 Windsor build. Single credible failure report, cause not conclusively established in-thread.
